title: Imported Messages
message:
Thank you for choosing our app and for your support!

If a channel isn’t working, please wait a moment and try again. It should start playing shortly.

During live events, you’ll find channels streaming live matches in the Live Event section.

For everything else, including News, Movies, Music, TV Shows, and more, head over to the Explore section.

Visit Worldwide to discover channels from around the globe.

Enjoy watching!
